# Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# 1. FORCE THE KNIT ROOT (Crucial for GitHub and organized sub-folders)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

# 2. Standard options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 4.8)

# 3. Load Libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(here) # install.packages("here")
  library(lubridate)
  library(stringr)

# 4. Paths (Anchored to Root)

fs::dir_create(c(out_dir, fig_dir))
```

# 1. Read in the spectral data
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(readr)

# Use here() to anchor the path to the project root
band_power        <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw", "EEG", "PSD", "BandPower_Night.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
percent_power     <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw", "EEG", "PSD", "PercPower_Night.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
percent_power_REM <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw", "EEG", "PSD", "PercPower_Night_REM.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
band_power_REM    <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw", "EEG", "PSD", "BandPower_Night_REM.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

band_power <- band_power %>%
  mutate(Night = recode(Night, 
                        "Baseline" = "BSL",
                        "SRT_1"    = "1",

                        "SRT_5"    = "5",
                        "SRT_6"    = "6",
                        "SRT_7"    = "7",
                        "FollowUp" = "FU"))

percent_power <- percent_power %>%

                        "Baseline" = "BSL",
                        "SRT_1"    = "1",
                        "SRT_2"    = "2",
                        "SRT_3"    = "3",
                        "SRT_4"    = "4",
                        "SRT_5"    = "5",
                        "SRT_6"    = "6",
                        "SRT_7"    = "7",
                        "FollowUp" = "FU"))
```

# 2. Plot the data
```{r}
# 1. Prepare NREM data (All bands)
plot_df_nrem <- percent_power %>%
  select(Night, Participant, contains("(Mean)")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = contains("(Mean)"), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    variable = paste0("NREM ", str_remove(variable, " \\(Mean\\)")),
    Stage = "NREM"
  )

# 2. Prepare REM data (Theta only)
plot_df_rem <- percent_power_REM %>%
  select(Night, Participant, contains("(Mean)")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = contains("(Mean)"), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(str_detect(variable, "Theta")) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = "REM Theta",
    Stage = "REM"
  )
# Define the order of nights for all plots in this study
day_levels <- c("BSL", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "FU")

# 3. Combine and Summarize
# Define custom order: NREM bands first, then REM Theta
freq_order <- c("NREM SWA", "NREM Delta", "NREM Theta", "NREM Alpha", 
               "NREM Sigma", "NREM Beta", "REM Theta")

plot_df_combined <- bind_rows(plot_df_nrem, plot_df_rem) %>%
  group_by(Night, variable, Stage) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(pmax(sum(!is.na(value)), 1)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Night = factor(Night, levels = day_levels),
    variable = factor(variable, levels = freq_order)
  )

# 4. Create the Plot
# 4. Create the Plot
p_combined <- ggplot(plot_df_combined, aes(x = Night, y = mean, group = 1, color = Stage)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, shape = 17) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("NREM" = "#bc5090", "REM" = "#0091d4")) +
  theme(
    # Remove all grid lines
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    # Add solid black lines to both axes
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
    # Styling text
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), 
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Study Night", 
    y = expression(bold("Percentage Band Power (%)")),
    color = "Sleep Stage"
  )

# 5. Save the plot to fig_dir
ggsave(
  filename = here(fig_dir, "Figure 5.tiff"), 
  plot = p_combined, 
  width = 10, 
  height = 7, 
  dpi = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)

ggsave(
  filename = here::here(params$fig_dir, "Figure 5.jpg"), 
  plot = p_combined, 
  width = 10, 
  height = 7, 
  dpi = 300
)

# Display the plot
print(p_combined)
```


# 3. Summary stats REM theta - relative and absolute
```{r}
# Define the summary function
get_summary_table <- function(data, unit_label = "") {
  data %>%
    # 1. Convert band columns (Delta (Mean), etc.) into a long format
    pivot_longer(
      cols = contains("(Mean)"), 
      names_to = "band", 
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    # 2. Clean up band names
    mutate(band = str_remove(band, " \\(Mean\\)")) %>%
    # 3. Calculate statistics
    group_by(Night, band) %>%
    summarise(
      n  = sum(!is.na(value)),
      mn = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    # 4. Format and ensure correct night ordering
    mutate(
      `Mean (SD)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)%s", mn, sd, unit_label),
      Night = factor(Night, levels = c("BSL", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "FU"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(Night, band)
}

# --- 1. Generate Summaries ---
# Absolute Power (microvolts squared)
rem_abs_summary <- get_summary_table(band_power_REM)
rem_theta_abs_summary <- rem_abs_summary %>% filter(band == "Theta")

# Relative/Percent Power (%)
rem_rel_summary <- get_summary_table(percent_power_REM, unit_label = "%")
rem_theta_rel_summary <- rem_rel_summary %>% filter(band == "Theta")


# --- 2. Create HTML Tables for the Report ---
rem_theta_rel_summary %>%
  select(Night, n, `Mean (SD)`) %>%
  kable(caption = "REM Theta Relative Power Summary (%)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)


```

# 5. LMM and Formatted Table for report
```{r}
# 1. Data Prep Function
prep_data_long <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = contains("(Mean)"), names_to = "band", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(
      band = str_remove(band, " \\(Mean\\)"),
      Night = factor(Night, levels = c("BSL", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "FU"))
    )
}

# 2. LMM Function
run_lmm_with_n <- function(long_df) {
  bands <- unique(long_df$band)
  map_dfr(bands, function(b) {
    dat <- filter(long_df, band == b) %>% filter(!is.na(value)) %>% droplevels()
    
    stats <- dat %>%
      group_by(Night) %>%
      summarise(n_night = n_distinct(Participant), mn = mean(value, na.rm=TRUE), sd = sd(value, na.rm=TRUE), .groups = "drop")

    fit <- lmer(value ~ Night + (1|Participant), data = dat)
    emm <- emmeans(fit, "Night")
    ctr <- summary(contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 1), infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)) %>% as.data.frame()
    d_sum <- summary(eff_size(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 1, sigma = sigma(fit), edf = df.residual(fit))) %>% as.data.frame()
    
    ctr <- ctr %>% mutate(Night = str_remove(contrast, " - BSL"))
    d_sum <- d_sum %>% mutate(Night = str_remove(contrast, " - BSL"))
    
    stats %>%
      left_join(select(ctr, Night, estimate, lower.CL, upper.CL), by = "Night") %>%
      left_join(select(d_sum, Night, d = effect.size), by = "Night") %>%
      mutate(band = b, n_total = n_distinct(dat$Participant))
  })
}

# 3. HTML Table Function (for RMarkdown display)
format_pub_table_with_n <- function(results_df, title = "Table") {
  display_df <- results_df %>%
    mutate(
      `Mean (SD)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mn, sd),
      Diff_adj = ifelse(Night == "BSL", "-", sprintf("%.2f", estimate)),
      `95% CI` = ifelse(Night == "BSL", "-", sprintf("%.2f to %.2f", lower.CL, upper.CL)),
      d = ifelse(Night == "BSL", "-", sprintf("%.2f", d)),
      Night_Label = recode(Night, "BSL" = "Baseline", "FU" = "Follow up", 
                          "1"="Night 1", "2"="Night 2", "3"="Night 3", "4"="Night 4", 
                          "5"="Night 5", "6"="Night 6", "7"="Night 7")
    ) %>%
    group_by(band) %>%
    do({
      header_row <- tibble(Night_Label = paste0("**", .$band[1], " (n = ", .$n_total[1], ")**"),
                           `Mean (SD)` = "", Diff_adj = "", `95% CI` = "", d = "")
      bind_rows(header_row, select(., Night_Label, `Mean (SD)`, Diff_adj, `95% CI`, d))
    }) %>% ungroup() %>% select(Night_Label, `Mean (SD)`, Diff_adj, `95% CI`, d)

  indent_rows <- which(!grepl("\\*\\*", display_df$Night_Label))
  display_df %>%
    knitr::kable(escape = FALSE, caption = title, col.names = c("Power Spectral Density", "Mean (SD)", "Diff_adj", "95% CI", "d")) %>%
    kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>% add_indent(indent_rows)
}
```

# 6. Formatted Tables
```{r}
# --- 1. Run Statistical Models (Absolute & Relative) ---
# NREM
res_nrem_abs <- run_lmm_with_n(prep_data_long(band_power))
res_nrem_rel <- run_lmm_with_n(prep_data_long(percent_power))

# REM (Theta only)
res_rem_abs <- run_lmm_with_n(prep_data_long(band_power_REM)) %>% filter(band == "Theta")
res_rem_rel <- run_lmm_with_n(prep_data_long(percent_power_REM)) %>% filter(band == "Theta")

# --- 2. Display Tables in Report (Relative as Example) ---
format_pub_table_with_n(res_nrem_rel, "Table: NREM Relative Power (%)")
format_pub_table_with_n(res_rem_rel, "Table: REM Theta Relative Power (%)")

# --- 3. Save All to Excel (4 Sheets) ---
get_pub_table_df <- function(results_df) {
  results_df %>%
    mutate(
      `Mean (SD)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mn, sd),
      Diff_adj = ifelse(Night == "BSL", "-", sprintf("%.2f", estimate)),
      `95% CI` = ifelse(Night == "BSL", "-", sprintf("%.2f to %.2f", lower.CL, upper.CL)),
      `Cohen's d` = ifelse(Night == "BSL", "-", sprintf("%.2f", d)),
      Timepoint = recode(Night, "BSL" = "Baseline", "FU" = "Follow up", "1"="Night 1", "2"="Night 2", "3"="Night 3", "4"="Night 4", "5"="Night 5", "6"="Night 6", "7"="Night 7")
    ) %>%
    select(band, Timepoint, `Mean (SD)`, Diff_adj, `95% CI`, `Cohen's d`)
}

wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()

# Add NREM Sheets
openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "NREM_Absolute")
openxlsx::writeData(wb, "NREM_Absolute", get_pub_table_df(res_nrem_abs))

openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "NREM_Relative")
openxlsx::writeData(wb, "NREM_Relative", get_pub_table_df(res_nrem_rel))

# Add REM Sheets
openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "REM_Theta_Absolute")
openxlsx::writeData(wb, "REM_Theta_Absolute", get_pub_table_df(res_rem_abs))

openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "REM_Theta_Relative")
openxlsx::writeData(wb, "REM_Theta_Relative", get_pub_table_df(res_rem_rel))

# Save the workbook
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, here(out_dir, "PSD_LMM_results.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```
